text: A cultivator in travel-worn robes stops at your village well. His eyes linger on you for a moment longer than on the other children.

choices.label: Kneel and beg to be taught

outcomes.text: He sighs, then recites a short manual. "Never say where you learned it."
"Not everyone is meant for this road." He walks on and you stay on your knees until dusk.

choices.label: Carry his bags for the month he stays

outcomes.text: On his last night he tosses you a scroll. "Payment."
He thanks you, and leaves a handful of coins.
He laughs and flips you a copper.

text: You find a traveler bleeding beside the road. Someone has clearly hunted him. He clutches a oilcloth bundle.

choices.label: Stay with him until the end

outcomes.text: His last breath is a request: keep the bundle, and keep it hidden. Inside is a cultivation manual.
He dies before he can say a word. You bury him.

choices.label: Rifle through his pack and leave

outcomes.text: Under the coins is a scroll. You run before the hunters return.
Just a few coins.

text: Heavy rain has brought down the old hillside shrine. Behind the broken altar there is a hollow in the wall.

outcomes.text: Behind the altar, wrapped in waxed cloth, is a manual.
The wall comes down on your arm.
You pray, and walk home dry.

text: A merchant house keeps a locked room of old books, and a clerk who is happy to take bribes.

choices.label: Pay 80 gold for an hour in the room

outcomes.text: In an hour you copy what you can, and a manual's worth of it is real.
The clerk sold you a forgery. You smile, and you leave.
A clerk's price is never as low as it looks.

text: The village's old hermit says he once walked the immortal road. Nobody believes him but you are curious.

choices.label: Do his chores for a season and listen

outcomes.text: He teaches you a breathing rhyme. "Say it to nobody."
He is only a lonely old man. You enjoy his stories anyway.

choices.label: Mock him with the other children

outcomes.text: The hermit just watches you go. You feel small.

text: Rumours fly: someone talks about the manual you are hiding. Two men in dark robes ask questions about you at the inn.

outcomes.text: The questions stop. Nobody ever learns what you have.
They find it. You are beaten and robbed, but not killed.
They find it, and they do not leave witnesses.
You make it to a new town and a new name.
They catch you on the road and take it all.

choices.label: Sell the manual to the local lord

outcomes.text: The lord pays well and smiles. You are forgotten, and so is the manual.

text: Three robed recruiters have set up tables in the market square, testing children and young villagers for spiritual talent. Most are turned away.

choices.label: Take the Azure Cloud Sect's test

outcomes.text: The elder's stone glows. "A little crude, but there is something here." You are taken in as an outer disciple and given a basic manual.
"Come back when you can feel qi." The recruiter's eyes were already on the next child.

choices.label: Take the Blood Moon Sect's test

outcomes.text: The recruiter smiles with too many teeth. "Strong. Hungry. You will do."
"Come back when you can feel qi." The recruiter's eyes were already on the next child.

choices.label: Take the Verdant Pill Pavilion's test

outcomes.text: They check your hands, your eyes, and your patience. "Clever enough to learn herbs." You get a manual and a job.
"Come back when you can feel qi." The recruiter's eyes were already on the next child.
Your family needs you, and the recruiters leave by sunset.
